branch_activations.boundary: The local order is not dismissed as fictitious or irrelevant.

branch_activations.activation: Royal authority contacts exclusive divine judgment through the contrast between what the king's order permits and what divine willing can make effective.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Human sovereignty is nested inside the judgment domain named by the focus.
branch_activations.boundary: No general theory of political authority is drawn beyond this supplied sequence.

branch_activations.carrier: The 12:76 willing occurrences carry the condition under which the alternate procedure reaches its result.

branch_activations.activation: Divine willing contacts procedural plurality by making one route effective without granting the route independent ownership.

branch_activations.boundary: The attributed trace does not claim to explain the full metaphysics of divine willing.

findings.title: The vessel reverses the gate pattern
findings.claim: The focus's distribution across many apertures may be echoed later by a reversible aperture logic: attention spreads across many containers and then reconcentrates on one concealed vessel.
findings.mechanism: The focus gate and dispersal carriers establish one-to-many movement, while 12:72 supplies the missing vessel and 12:76 supplies repeated containers and extraction. The later search turns plurality into the field through which one hidden site is selected.
findings.reader_payoff: The many-gate advice gains an exploratory formal echo: distribution can preserve a field of possibilities that later permits precise convergence.
findings.containment: This is a surprising attributed cross-domain resonance, not a synonym claim between باب and صواع or وعاء. The ordinary gate instruction and the simpler one-time-dispersion reading remain intact.

epistemic.reason: The exact pericope carriers and the HFT focus anchor are supplied, but the vessel-to-gate relation is explicitly exploratory and all contextual vessel branches lack registered glosses or facets.

branch_activations.activation: The many gates contact the later vessel through the shared one-to-many structure of distributed access and focused discovery.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus distribution can be reread as the first form of an aperture pattern later reversed by search.
branch_activations.boundary: The gate and vessel forms are not being declared lexically identical.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir bütünü birden çok parçaya veya kümeye ayırıp dağıtma.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's dispersion can serve as the first movement in a distribution-and-convergence pattern.

branch_activations.boundary: No registered branch gloss or facet is supplied, and no lexical identity between the objects is claimed.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The formal echo ends with one concealed site becoming the point of convergence.
branch_activations.boundary: No registered branch gloss or facet is supplied and no literal equivalence is claimed.
